proof_sketch: The race condition requires thread N to read shared_max[M] before thread M writes its updated value in the previous reduction step. With 256 threads across 8 warps, cross-warp races occur at s=128 (warp 0-3 reading from warp 4-7 init positions) and s=64 (warp 0-1 reading from warp 2-3 updated positions). Without __syncthreads(), thread 63 may read stale shared_max[127] before thread 127 completes its s=128 update. This requires the true max to exist ONLY in positions 128-255 and propagate through position 127.
